# internet-data

Collects public Internet measurements, normalizes them into one validated model and publishes small static views for lateeflaw.info (a homepage globe now, an Internet Intelligence Dashboard at `/intelligence/` later).

**Status: Gate 2B hosting rehearsal. Everything this repository publishes is SIMULATED test data.** It is generated by a seeded model, contains no RIPE Atlas data and no real measurement, and says so in its schema (`provenance.simulated`) and in every document. The collector makes no network request while `config/publication.json` is `synthetic`. Nothing derived from RIPE Atlas may be published until the RIPE NCC has answered in writing.

- `contracts/` the versioned JSON Schema
- `src/` adapters (RIPE Atlas ping; the synthetic fixture for the rehearsal), normalization, curation, publication gate, guarded HTTP, collector CLI
- `config/` the ten anchor locations, the kill switch, the publication permission
- `test/` synthetic RIPE-shaped fixtures only; no real measurement data is stored here
- `scripts/` mutation proofs, history audit, upstream check of the pinned GitHub Actions
- `docs/OPERATIONS.md` how it runs, the kill switch and its drill, setup permissions
- `docs/CONTRACTS.md` the model and the 90-to-45 reduction rules

```
npm test
```

No dependencies: Node 20 or newer, built-in modules only.
